decisions.decision: Nebo map ground truth (the actual route-track image) is more reliable evidence than a post's own stored lat/lon or location text when they conflict -- always view the image directly (Read tool handles images) and cross-check against the post's narrative rather than trusting reverse-geocoded coordinates alone
decisions.rationale: Repeatedly confirmed this session: reverse-geocoding a stored coordinate and finding a plausible-sounding nearby place name is not sufficient evidence when the coordinate itself can be wrong (Mighty Mississippi was 250mi off, Cape May/Sandy Hook shared duplicated data)
